Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misidentification of the father's birthplace due to reliance on a single search result snippet (Wikipedia) without cross-verification against other authoritative sources at the initial step. The Planner incorrectly assumed the birthplace was Sochi based on the first search result, failing to anticipate or investigate the conflicting information (Nizhny Novgorod) that appeared later in the conversation. This premature conclusion led to a cycle of redundant searches and failed attempts to resolve the discrepancy, as the Planner did not properly synthesize the conflicting data from the very beginning.
